557720545:buried.h: A.Rogers Is Too Good to Sit, and Portal Suitors Know It
557720545:buried.d: [[p:557720545|A.Rogers]], an 84-overall junior back, has barely played. Portal teams see a starter, and a source says he's asking whether his future is elsewhere.

quote.text: He's a guy who should be playing. He knows it and so does his camp.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557719944:buried.h: Stuck at No. 4 on Tennessee's Depth Chart, Q.Porter May Not Wait
557719944:buried.d: [[p:557719944|Q.Porter]] is a 90-overall junior receiver who would start for most programs. At Tennessee he's fourth on the chart, and several portal suitors are already interested.

quote.text: He's too talented to be fourth. Half the league would start him tomorrow.
quote.by: a rival coach

557724828:sinking.h: S.Hiter deserves better than 2-10, and contenders will call
557724828:sinking.d: [[p:557724828|S.Hiter]] is a 90-overall sophomore running back stuck on a [[t:832438339|Michigan]] team that finished 2-10. If he hits the portal, he becomes the story of the offseason. Contenders are already doing their homework.

quote.text: You don't find backs like that on a team that bad. Staffs are already making their lists.
quote.by: a rival personnel evaluator

557719383:fit.h: Oregon's Struggling Pass Defense Could Push Obidegwu Toward the Portal
557719383:fit.d: Oregon ranks 128th of 138 in pass defense, and [[p:557719383|I.Obidegwu]], an 89-overall field corner, may want out. The portal could be the way, and the Ducks' recruiting pitch on defense could take a hit.

quote.text: Corners that good want to play in a system that protects them.
quote.by: a source familiar with the situation

561120631battle.h: Utah clings to five-star D. Iorio as Michigan refuses to fold
561120631battle.d: [[t:832438400|Utah]] still holds the lead for [[r:561120631|D. Iorio]], but [[t:832438339|Michigan]] has kept working and Indiana is hovering. Iorio's dealbreaker is playing style, and that is where the Wolverines think they can steal him.

quote.text: He keeps coming back to how they'd use him. That's the whole recruitment.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

561123531battle.h: Florida State leads for D. Calvin, but Utah is pushing back
561123531battle.d: [[t:832438310|Florida State]] has the edge for four-star C [[r:561123531|D. Calvin]]. [[t:832438400|Utah]] hasn't folded, and Boise State is still in the mix. Playing style is the dealbreaker, so the next conversations with position coaches could matter most.

quote.text: Nobody's out of it. He wants to hear exactly how the offense will run through the middle.
quote.by: a person familiar with Calvin's thinking

561119612battle.h: LSU's Championship Pitch Is Putting Real Heat on SMU for Egan
561119612battle.d: SMU still has the lead for [[r:561119612|C. Egan]], but [[t:832438333|LSU]] sells the title-contender story he says he wants. Memphis is hanging around, and official visits could settle it.

quote.text: He wants to win it all. LSU keeps saying that out loud, and he's listening.
quote.by: a person familiar with his thinking

557720542:underpaid.h: Will Washington Be the Team That Pays D.Roebuck?
557720542:underpaid.d: [[p:557720542|D.Roebuck]] is a 94-overall receiver earning nothing in NIL, and that mismatch rarely lasts once the portal opens. [[t:832438408|Washington]] is the name some collectives keep bringing up.

quote.text: Somebody will make him an offer he can't ignore. It's just a matter of who.
quote.by: a collective source

557720030:underpaid.h: Miami Has a Bargain in Pringle Jr. for Now
557720030:underpaid.d: [[p:557720030|G.Pringle Jr.]] is a 91-overall back making nothing in NIL. [[t:832438337|Miami]] has the money to fix that, but rival collectives are already doing the math on what he'd cost.

quote.text: If Miami doesn't take care of him, somebody else will.
quote.by: a source close to a rival collective

557714033:underpaid.h: Rival Collectives Are Circling Clemson's G.Davidson
557714033:underpaid.d: [[p:557714033|G.Davidson]] is a 92-overall back with no NIL money, and other programs have noticed. [[t:832438293|Clemson]] has deep pockets, but the Tigers are also dealing with portal rumors elsewhere on the roster.

quote.text: Backs like that don't last. Some collectives already have his number.
quote.by: a rival staffer

561124180battle.h: Army, Minnesota and Penn State All Want Holly. Only One Gets Him
561124180battle.d: Army has a thin lead for [[r:561124180|P. Holly]], with Minnesota right there and Penn State close enough to matter. Playing time drives his decision, and a wide-open receiver room gives each school a pitch.

quote.text: Every staff is telling him he'll play early. He's trying to figure out who means it.
quote.by: a rival recruiting staffer

561122828commit.h: Georgia lands WR J. Cassidy, who sees an early path to playing
561122828commit.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] picked up four-star WR [[r:561122828|J. Cassidy]] from Jacksonville. [[p:557713174|I.Canion]] is out of eligibility after this season, which leaves the Bulldogs' receiver room wide open. Georgia's staff needed a win on the trail.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.
quote.by: J. Cassidy

561121725commit.h: Oklahoma City's D. Baker picks SMU, and the Sooners feel it
561121725commit.d: Four-star TE [[r:561121725|D. Baker]] is staying in the region and committing to [[t:832438375|SMU]]. The Mustangs sold him on conference prestige and a short trip home. Oklahoma will notice losing a local kid.

quote.text: I'm representing Oklahoma City. Staying close was always the plan.
quote.by: D. Baker

561123185commit.h: Notre Dame's DB pipeline lands four-star SS B. Murphey
561123185commit.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] added four-star SS [[r:561123185|B. Murphey]]. The Irish lead the nation in pro potential at defensive back, with five draft picks there in four years, and they're 11-2 and ranked No. 6. Murphey's camp was impressed by the draft board.

quote.text: They showed me the draft board. That's where I'm going.
quote.by: B. Murphey

561124407commit.h: Tennessee gets C. Poe, and his mom gets Saturdays
561124407commit.d: Four-star MIKE [[r:561124407|C. Poe]] picked [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] over the other programs after his home visits. The Vols are 11-3 and ranked No. 12, and Virginia Beach is a short drive from Knoxville. The winning and the proximity both mattered.

quote.text: My mom gets to see me play every Saturday. That was huge for me.
quote.by: C. Poe

561124684commit.h: Hometown safety O. Hoppes gives East Carolina a win
561124684commit.d: One-star FS [[r:561124684|O. Hoppes]] is staying in North Carolina and committing to [[t:832438301|East Carolina]]. His parents will make every home game, and with [[p:557727961|T.Love]] and [[p:557719784|C.Peterson]] out of eligibility after this season, the safety room has room for him. Pirate_flag takes it.

quote.text: I wanted to stay close to home. East Carolina just felt like family.
quote.by: O. Hoppes

557711762:struggling.h: Oregon State's patience with B.Atkinson may be wearing thin
557711762:struggling.d: [[p:557711762|B.Atkinson]] has thrown for 3229 yards, 17 touchdowns and 7 picks with a 133.9 rating. That isn't good enough for a 90-overall quarterback at [[t:832438365|Oregon State]]. Another rough month and the questions get louder.

quote.text: Nobody's panicking, but the staff expected more from him. People are paying attention.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557718144:sinking.h: A.Marsh is wasted on a 4-8 TCU team, and rivals know it
557718144:sinking.d: [[p:557718144|A.Marsh]] is a 91-overall junior receiver on a TCU team that finished 4-8. If he reaches the portal, he becomes the story of the offseason. Contenders have already noticed.

quote.text: If he's out there, every contender will be calling within the hour.
quote.by: a rival assistant coach

561123778battle.h: Florida State Clings to Lead for Melton as Tennessee Pushes
561123778battle.d: Florida State is ahead for [[r:561123778|C. Melton]], but Tennessee is close and Michigan State is still in the mix. Playing time is his dealbreaker, and one more good week for the Seminoles might end it.

quote.text: He wants to see a real path to the field. Whoever shows it wins.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561123994commit.h: Texas A&M Keeps a Four-Star Safety Home With Hack Pledge
561123994commit.d: [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] landed four-star safety [[r:561123994|J. Hack]], who gets power-conference football without leaving Texas. His parents can be at every home game.

quote.text: I want to test myself against the best, and I get to do it in front of my family.
quote.by: J. Hack

561122973commit.h: Indiana Adds Four-Star Receiver Bighill, and the Pro Pitch Worked
561122973commit.d: [[t:832438319|Indiana]] landed four-star receiver [[r:561122973|C. Bighill]]. The Hoosiers sold power-conference football and a track record of sending receivers to the NFL, including two in the first round.

quote.text: They showed me the draft board. Receivers leave there and get picked.
quote.by: C. Bighill

557718955:underpaid.h: D.Moore Is a 95-Overall Receiver With No NIL Deal. Oregon Should Worry
557718955:underpaid.d: [[p:557718955|D.Moore]] is playing like one of the best receivers in the country and earning nothing in NIL. Oregon's collective is among the richest, but rivals know the market price at his position is far higher.

quote.text: Everybody's talking about it. Players that good don't stay unpaid long.
quote.by: an agent who works with college players

557717144:buried.h: Q.Joyner Is Too Good to Sit. A Transfer May Be Coming
557717144:buried.d: [[p:557717144|Q.Joyner]] is an 88-overall sophomore back who has barely played. Portal teams would hand him the job, and the lack of carries could lead to a transfer.

quote.text: He's patient but he isn't blind. He wants a real role.
quote.by: a person close to the player

557717043:struggling.h: Is LSU Ready to Move On From D.Jones?
557717043:struggling.d: [[p:557717043|D.Jones]] averaged just 3.3 yards a carry, which is hard to justify for an 85-overall back on a ranked team. [[t:832438333|LSU]]'s staff faces a decision before next season, and the portal is an obvious way to answer it.

quote.text: They expected more. They'll look for it if they don't get it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557725326:struggling.h: R.Marriott Was Supposed to Be a Star. The Numbers Disagree
557725326:struggling.d: [[p:557725326|R.Marriott]], an 86-overall quarterback, threw 13 touchdowns against 14 interceptions. His staff may look at other options in the portal, and that could set off a chain reaction at the position.

quote.text: It isn't what anyone expected. They're going to look around.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557722672:struggling.h: Ratings Say 86. J.Washington's Stat Sheet Says Something Else
557722672:struggling.d: [[p:557722672|J.Washington]] ran for 421 yards on 106 carries, an unremarkable 4.0 per carry for an 86-overall back. The staff has a decision to make before next season, and the portal is an option.

quote.text: The talent is there. The production just hasn't matched it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557720545:stayed:2027.h: Buried on the depth chart, A.Rogers is still at Ohio State
557720545:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557720545|A.Rogers]] sat on Portal Watch for 5 weeks as one of our likeliest departures. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. Tuddy_roosevelt's staff apparently had a better pitch than the depth chart.

quote.text: They had to sell him on the plan, and they did.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557720389:stayed:2027.h: B.Riker passes on the portal despite feeling underpaid at Penn State
557720389:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557720389|B.Riker]] looked like a classic underpaid-for-his-rating case, and three weeks of Portal Watch heat didn't move him. He remains on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster, a small win for agerm40.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a person familiar with his thinking

557719944:stayed:2027.h: Tennessee talks Q.Porter out of the portal with a bigger NIL deal
557719944:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557719944|Q.Porter]] was buried on the depth chart, took heat for his numbers and looked gone. The [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] staff raised his NIL from 160K to 190K, and he's still on the roster.

quote.text: Honestly, I thought he was gone. The staff went to work on him.
quote.by: a rival staffer

557719455:stayed:2027.h: Michigan State keeps D.Olugbode after six weeks of departure chatter
557719455:stayed:2027.d: Losing wore on [[p:557719455|D.Olugbode]], and rival staffs were reportedly circling. [[t:832438340|Michigan State]] raised his NIL from 230K to 285K and he's staying. Spartans fans will take any win right now.

quote.text: They had to sell him on the plan, and they did.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557724828:stayed:2027.h: Michigan paid to keep S.Hiter, and it was closer than expected
557724828:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557724828|S.Hiter]] spent six weeks as one of the portal's most obvious flight risks on a losing team. [[t:832438339|Michigan]] raised his NIL from 115K to 195K, and he's still in Ann Arbor. Other staffs had reportedly made contact.

quote.text: That one was closer than people think.
quote.by: a person with knowledge of the talks

557726826:stayed:2027.h: J.Zayas stays at Penn State, easing worries in agerm40's secondary
557726826:stayed:2027.d: Scheme-fit questions had [[p:557726826|J.Zayas]] on Portal Watch for three weeks. He's still on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster, which matters for a secondary already under scrutiny.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557719002:stayed:2027.h: N.Pullard's rating jump didn't pry him away from Penn State
557719002:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557719002|N.Pullard]] was about to get expensive after a rating jump, which usually invites calls. He's still on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster, and agerm40's staff gets credit for keeping him in the loop.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557711879:stayed:2027.h: Ohio State holds on to J.Blue after his rating jump
557711879:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557711879|J.Blue]] hit Portal Watch for a week after a rating jump made him an expensive keeper. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. Tuddy_roosevelt can exhale on this one.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a person familiar with his thinking

557714154:stayed:2027.h: S.Boyce never seriously considered leaving Ohio State, sources say
557714154:stayed:2027.d: The rating jump put [[p:557714154|S.Boyce]] on Portal Watch, but the portal opened and he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. People close to the situation say the outside noise was louder than the reality.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557718955:stayed:2027.h: Oregon keeps D.Moore, a surprise given his pay and scheme fit
557718955:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557718955|D.Moore]] was underpaid for his rating, a poor scheme fit, and a likely departure. He's still on the [[t:832438364|Oregon]] roster. That answers one question for a Ducks program with a leaky pass defense.

quote.text: Honestly, I thought he was gone. The staff went to work on him.
quote.by: a rival staffer

832438359:exodus:2027.h: Ohio State's Portal Floodgates Open: 19 Gone, Two Five-Star Receivers Among Them
832438359:exodus:2027.d: Chris Henry Jr. and Jerquaden Guilford, both five-star receivers, are in the portal along with quarterback Tavien St. Clair and 16 others. Tuddy_roosevelt now has 14 four- and five-star holes to fill at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]].

quote.text: Nobody in that building thought it would be this many. It felt like everybody had been waiting for someone else to go first.
quote.by: a source close to the Ohio State program

832438366:exodus:2027.h: Penn State Sheds 13 Players, but the Names Hurt More Than the Count
832438366:exodus:2027.d: Cornerback Jahmir Joseph, quarterback Christian Flanagan and tackle Owen Aliciene lead the group leaving [[t:832438366|Penn State]]. Agerm40 can say the bleeding is limited, but he loses a starter-caliber piece in the secondary, at quarterback and on the line.

quote.text: They'll tell you it's just the normal churn. It doesn't feel normal when your corner and your QB are both in the portal.
quote.by: a rival staffer

832438301:exodus:2027.h: East Carolina Quietly Loses 12, Led by Edge Rusher Ethan Wilson
832438301:exodus:2027.d: Wilson, running back Ashton Gray and receiver Donnell Mitchell are among the 12 players who left [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] for the portal. It's no Ohio State-sized exodus, but Pirate_flag will feel it on the edge.

quote.text: Wilson was the one other staffs actually asked about. He's going to have plenty of options.
quote.by: a Group of Five assistant coach

557722831:gone:2027.h: I.West Exits Ohio State After Four Weeks Stuck on the Depth Chart
557722831:gone:2027.d: TD Wire flagged [[p:557722831|I.West]] for a month as a player buried at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. He's now in the portal. The only surprise is how long he waited.

quote.text: He wanted to play. He was tired of being told next year.
quote.by: a person close to West

557727811:gone:2027.h: D.Jones Leaves Ohio State's Crowded Depth Chart for the Portal
557727811:gone:2027.d: [[p:557727811|D.Jones]] had been on TD Wire's watch list for two weeks as a buried player. He's now in the portal, and [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]'s room is thinner for it.

quote.text: When you see the guys in front of you aren't going anywhere, you start making calls.
quote.by: a source familiar with Jones' thinking

557717122:gone:2027.h: J.Joseph's Exit Raises Questions About Penn State's Defensive Fit
557717122:gone:2027.d: Poor scheme fit was the warning sign on [[p:557717122|J.Joseph]] for three weeks, and now the cornerback is in the portal. Agerm40's secondary was already a storyline at [[t:832438366|Penn State]].

quote.text: He never felt comfortable in what they asked him to do. That's not a secret inside the building.
quote.by: a source close to the Penn State program

557713037:gone:2027.h: C.Flanagan Is Gone From Penn State Just as His Price Climbs
557713037:gone:2027.d: [[p:557713037|C.Flanagan]] was on the watch list for only a week after a rating jump made him pricey. Now the quarterback is in the portal, and [[t:832438366|Penn State]] has a hole at the position.

quote.text: A bump like that changes the conversation. Every QB-needy school is going to want to know what he costs.
quote.by: a rival recruiting staffer

557723610:gone:2027.h: L.Andrews Becomes Another Penn State Scheme Casualty
557723610:gone:2027.d: [[p:557723610|L.Andrews]] was flagged a week ago as a bad fit, and now he's in the portal. He joins J.Joseph in leaving [[t:832438366|Penn State]], which raises the question of what's going on with the fit.

557721477:gone:2027.h: T.St. Clair Leaves Ohio State After a Rough Stretch of Numbers
557721477:gone:2027.d: [[p:557721477|T.St. Clair]] was under fire for his production, and the quarterback is now in the portal. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has to answer for another departure at the most scrutinized position on the roster.

quote.text: The production wasn't where he wanted it. He's looking for a place that gives him a clean slate.
quote.by: a source close to the quarterback

561119306battle.h: Texas holds a sliver of an edge on Q. Vigil, but Oregon won't back off
561119306battle.d: [[r:561119306|Q. Vigil]] says conference prestige will decide it, and Texas and Oregon are pitching accordingly. Pittsburgh is a distant third but still calling. Both staffs are expected to push hard this week.

quote.text: He wants to know where he'll be playing on Saturdays against the best. Both schools have an answer.
quote.by: a rival recruiter

561121033battle.h: Minnesota has the lead on D. Crumpler, but Washington is making up ground
561121033battle.d: [[r:561121033|D. Crumpler]] wants a clear path to playing time, and Minnesota has been the staff to show him one. Washington is pushing back, Indiana is still in the mix, and official visits could settle it.

quote.text: He's heard 'you'll play' from everybody. Now he wants to see the depth chart.
quote.by: a person close to Crumpler

561123617battle.h: Michigan barely leads Notre Dame for R. Kashama, and home is the tiebreaker
561123617battle.d: [[r:561123617|R. Kashama]] has put proximity to home at the top of his list, and the gap between [[t:832438339|Michigan]] and Notre Dame is razor thin. One strong week from either staff could end it.

quote.text: His mom wants him within driving distance. That's been the quiet factor all along.
quote.by: a source close to the family

561121658commit.h: Miami adds four-star athlete T. Lefotu, and the Ohio State win helped
561121658commit.d: [[r:561121658|T. Lefotu]] wanted a bigger stage, and [[t:832438337|Miami]] is on one after beating No. 2 [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Per a source, the win helped close the deal.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.
quote.by: T. Lefotu

561125382commit.h: J. Petty chooses Texas Tech over Indiana, citing the Big 12 and a short path to playing time
561125382commit.d: [[r:561125382|J. Petty]] wanted a power-conference stage and a quick route to the field. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] offered both, with just two defensive tackles returning. Indiana came up short.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.
quote.by: J. Petty

561123536commit.h: Oklahoma lands HB B. Perkins, and NIL and TV exposure carried the day
561123536commit.d: [[r:561123536|B. Perkins]] came in with a reported $270K asking price and wanted maximum exposure. [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]], 9th in NIL spending, met both demands, according to a source close to the program.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.
quote.by: B. Perkins

561124786commit.h: Tennessee's title pitch works again: four-star WR Z. Cook is a Vol
561124786commit.d: [[r:561124786|Z. Cook]] wanted a real shot at a national title, and [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] sold him on it. With just three receivers returning, he can see the field fast. This is another sign the Asiodu momentum is carrying over.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.
quote.by: Z. Cook

561124273commit.h: Texas gets WR T. Cobb with a promise of early playing time
561124273commit.d: [[r:561124273|T. Cobb]] sees a receiver room with only four returners and wants to start right away. [[t:832438384|Texas]] is coming off a win over No. 25 [[t:832438300|Eastern Michigan]] and recruiting with confidence.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.
quote.by: T. Cobb

561124099commit.h: Texas Tech keeps edge T. Guy in-state, ahead of Kansas State and Utah
561124099commit.d: [[r:561124099|T. Guy]] never seriously considered leaving Texas, and with five edge rushers returning, [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] gave him a clear path to early snaps. Kansas State and [[t:832438400|Utah]] weren't able to move him.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.
quote.by: T. Guy

561125249battle.h: Miami, Georgia and Missouri are all in on HB K. Kane, with playing time the key
561125249battle.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] has the slimmest lead for [[r:561125249|K. Kane]], with [[t:832438312|Georgia]] right behind and Missouri not far back. He wants to know where he'll carry the ball, and one strong week could decide it.

quote.text: He's asking every staff the same question: when do I play?
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

561123819commit.h: East Carolina lands two-star center F. Ryland, and H0ldStillPlease closed it personally
561123819commit.d: [[c:H0ldStillPlease|H0ldStillPlease]] made the final push for [[r:561123819|F. Ryland]], pitching a depth chart with only two centers returning. [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] is looking to patch the interior after a heavy offseason of losses.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.
quote.by: F. Ryland

561124318commit.h: Clemson gets four-star D. Worley by selling him on the NFL pipeline
561124318commit.d: [[r:561124318|D. Worley]] wants to play on Sundays, and [[t:832438293|Clemson]] has a record of producing linebackers who do. With just three linebackers returning, he could be on the field early.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.
quote.by: D. Worley

561122217commit.h: Tennessee adds four-star HB L. Wood, who trusted the staff's résumé
561122217commit.d: [[r:561122217|L. Wood]] picked [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] because of its coaches, and sources say that credibility mattered more to him than any other pitch. It was a second big win for the Vols this week.

quote.text: You trust the guys who've done it. This staff has done it.
quote.by: L. Wood

561120814commit.h: Alabama gets WR P. Hyde, and the NIL machine is rolling again
561120814commit.d: [[r:561120814|P. Hyde]] reportedly wanted $270K and a national spotlight. [[t:832438274|Alabama]], 6th in NIL spending, delivered on both. Rival staffs are asking whether anyone can match that kind of offer.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.
quote.by: P. Hyde

561124975commit.h: D. Leake leaves home for Texas A&M, and power-conference status won out
561124975commit.d: [[r:561124975|D. Leake]] had said staying close to home was a dealbreaker, yet he picked [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] across the country. A source says conference prestige was too strong to pass up.

quote.text: It was hard to leave home, but this is about my future.
quote.by: D. Leake

561119887commit.h: It was never close: I. Woodhead picks Indiana and its title push
561119887commit.d: [[r:561119887|I. Woodhead]] wanted to play for a contender, and [[t:832438319|Indiana]] convinced him quickly. The Hoosiers' record of getting running backs to the league only strengthened the case.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.
quote.by: I. Woodhead

557719383:stayed:2027.h: Portal Watch regular I. Obidegwu stays at Oregon after NIL raise
557719383:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557719383|I.Obidegwu]] spent four weeks on our watch list over scheme fit, but he is still with [[t:832438364|Oregon]]. A raise from 155K to 195K appears to have helped the staff keep him around.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557717144:stayed:2027.h: Texas Tech keeps buried Q. Joyner with a pay bump
557717144:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557717144|Q.Joyner]] was stuck on the depth chart, but [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] raised his NIL from 110K to 145K, and he is still on the roster with the portal open.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557726198:stayed:2027.h: J. Smith stays at Georgia despite a stretch on the watch list
557726198:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557726198|J.Smith]] spent three weeks on Portal Watch, in part for being underpaid. The portal is open, but he is still a Bulldog.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557715427:stayed:2027.h: C. Gooden stays at Colorado after a raise from nothing
557715427:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557715427|C.Gooden]] was a scheme-fit concern on Portal Watch, but [[t:832438295|Colorado]] moved his NIL from 0K to 65K, and he's staying.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557726994:fit.h: L. Bey is a backfield weapon in an Ohio State offense that doesn't throw to backs
557726994:fit.d: [[p:557726994|L.Bey]], an 87-overall back, plays for a team ranked 121st of 138 in receptions. After the roster turnover in Columbus, Tuddy_roosevelt may have to convince him to stay.

quote.text: Guys like that look at how they're being used, and then they start taking calls.
quote.by: an agent familiar with the market

557718302:underpaid.h: J. Mbatchou is making nothing, and Florida could be the school to change that
557718302:underpaid.d: [[p:557718302|J.Mbatchou]] is an 85-overall defensive tackle earning no NIL, while peers at his rating get around 105K. [[t:832438308|Florida]] is one of several programs that have reportedly kicked the tires.

quote.text: There's a market for him. Everyone knows he's underpaid.
quote.by: a rival staffer

557725988:underpaid.h: A. Rowden is a bargain at Texas Tech, but for how long?
557725988:underpaid.d: [[p:557725988|A.Rowden]] is an 84-overall back earning nothing in NIL, while similar players command around 85K. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] ranks 8th in NIL and has resources to keep him if it moves soon.

quote.text: Somebody will offer him real money. Texas Tech has to get ahead of it.
quote.by: a rival collective source

557723756:underpaid.h: Rival collectives are targeting James Madison WR K. Billiot
557723756:underpaid.d: [[p:557723756|K.Billiot]] is an 86-overall receiver earning nothing, and others at his level get about 90K. [[t:832438323|James Madison]] ranks 80th in NIL spending and can't win a bidding war.

quote.text: JMU can't match what bigger programs will put on the table.
quote.by: a source with a rival collective

557717405:buried.h: C. Knighten is No. 2 on East Carolina's depth chart and may look elsewhere
557717405:buried.d: [[p:557717405|C.Knighten]] is an 81-overall junior back with just three snaps in 12 games. [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] and Pirate_flag could lose him to a team that would start him tomorrow.

quote.text: A guy like that is waiting for an opportunity to play, and a lot of teams would give it to him.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557719085:buried.h: K. Mothudi is too good to sit, and a transfer could be coming
557719085:buried.d: [[p:557719085|K.Mothudi]] is an 84-overall junior middle linebacker who played 86 snaps in 13 games. Any team in the portal market would start him right away, and the questions about his future are growing.

quote.text: He's earned a bigger role. If he doesn't get it, he'll look around.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557712371:sinking.h: K. Blackwell would be the portal's top prize if he leaves a 4-8 Kentucky team
557712371:sinking.d: [[p:557712371|K.Blackwell]], an 88-overall junior corner, is on a Kentucky team that went 4-8. If he enters the portal, programs will line up.

quote.text: Every contender with a hole at corner will call him.
quote.by: a rival defensive staffer
